model.name: Tests never touch prod — every test runs against an isolated server; prod is opt-in only
model.description: 283 of 439 test/visual gate scripts connected to the live server (prod.wo-da.de:4444, or localhost:4444 on the prod box); 25 create rooms there and 13 never delete them. Every test must run against an isolated server it owns (own port, own DATA_DIR, own scenario dir). Prod is reached only by an explicit opt-in and only by a read-only smoke check after deploy.
model.poDirective: Tron 2026-11-22: radical consolidation of test users and CI, run by a separate Claude Code agent (not the oopTeam fleet).

acceptanceCriteria.text: A test script with no environment set connects to the isolated server (https://localhost:4445), never to prod.

gateRef.assertion: grep test/ for prod.wo-da.de / localhost:4444 used as a connection target → 0 hits

acceptanceCriteria.text: Reaching prod requires RAWBIN_TARGET=prod and prints a warning.

gateRef.assertion: run a gate without RAWBIN_TARGET → it targets localhost:4445

acceptanceCriteria.text: A full test run leaves prod's room and user counts unchanged.

gateRef.assertion: scripts/list-test-pollution.mjs on prod before/after a run → identical
